SkyExpo Orlando. Exhibitor badge. Karina Macedo, Macedo Aviation, Hall B, booth forty-two. The exhibition is opening on Tuesday at nine a.m. The airshow is starting at three p.m.
Hi, Karina! I hear you are attending SkyExpo in Orlando next week.
Yes! We are bringing our new brochures. Our booth is in Hall B.
Great. When are you arriving?
I'm flying to Orlando on Monday. What are you doing on Tuesday?
I'm meeting two clients in the morning, but I'm free in the afternoon.
Perfect. Are you coming to the airshow on Wednesday?
Yes, I am. I'm watching it with my partners. Do you want to come with us?
I'd love to! Do I need a ticket?
No. Exhibitors don't need a ticket. Just show your badge.
Great. See you at the booth on Tuesday afternoon, Mike!

Hello, Ms. Macedo. This is Tom Hayes from the SkyExpo office in Orlando. Thank you for registering. Your booth is in Hall B, number forty-two. The exhibition is opening on Tuesday at nine a.m., but you can prepare your booth on Monday afternoon. We are sending you five free tickets for your clients. And the airshow is starting at three p.m. every day. See you next week!

Hi, Karina, it's Anna Brooks, from Brooks Flight School in Texas. I saw your name on the SkyExpo list. I'm attending, too! My team is bringing two training planes to the exhibition. I'm arriving in Orlando on Monday night. On Tuesday morning, I'm giving a short talk in Hall A about flight schools. Are you free on Wednesday? I'm having lunch with two exhibitors from Brazil, and I'd like you to meet them. Call me back!

First, Karina registers her company for SkyExpo. Then, her team prepares new brochures in English. Next, she flies to Orlando on Monday. After that, she meets three clients at her booth on Tuesday. Finally, she watches the airshow with Mike on Wednesday.
